blocks.p: A spreadsheet assumes every client pays on the due date. Real clients don't.

blocks.b: Swipe to see what that costs.

blocks.p: $188,900 of bills land in a single week: the staff bonus, payroll and insurance.
The forecast shows $19,934 left, $10,066 under the $30,000 minimum.

blocks.b: The spreadsheet said you were fine.

blocks.p: Cash Gap Forecaster reads three years of invoices and payments and learns how each client really pays.
One hotel client pays about 42 days late, across 52 invoices. The forecast uses that, not the due date.

blocks.b: The gap shows up over a month before it happens.

blocks.p: Move the staff bonus back two weeks and the forecast updates.
Week six closing cash goes from $19,934 to $102,934. Weeks 12 and 13 still dip, and now there's time to plan.
Our next post is an 85-second video: a wholesale bakery, a late-paying client and the fix.
